headline: Share India Securities Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed herewith the intimation regarding the dilution of the Company s shareholding in Silverleaf Securities Research Private Limited, a subsidiary…
detail: Acquisition - Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed herewith the intimation regarding the dilution of the Company s shareholding in Silverleaf Securities Research Private Limited, a subsidiary of the Company, pursuant to non-participation in the Rights Issue.
